searches.reason: Explore a NextItNet extension that learns which recent events matter through jointly trained gates and multiscale causal convolutions. This targets stale-interest carryover while preserving one network per category; compare receptive-field and recency ablations using macro validation HR@10.

searches.reason: Investigate whether stronger training negatives improve candidate ranking, especially in Electronics. Compare multi-negative sampled softmax and false-negative-aware hard-negative mining within one NextItNet model. Sampled training margins alone do not establish generalization; keep the host validation candidates unchanged.
searches.query: sequential recommendation sampled softmax hard negative mining false negative correction NextItNet ranking 2023 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Find ways to jointly learn item identity and title/description representations inside NextItNet using only supplied training data and no pretrained weights. Test whether semantic supervision distinguishes specific recent interests from broad relevance; do not assume titles establish compatibility or purchase intent.
searches.query: sequential recommendation jointly trained item ID text embeddings title description causal convolution semantic auxiliary learning from scratch 2023 2024 2025 2026
